manifest_summary.approach: Public-close-only long/cash trend gate: enter only when mean 10/20-bar log return exceeds 0.006 and 5-bar log return is positive. Otherwise retain cash. Entry targets half of capital with a 10% next-close buffer, which is not a guaranteed bound. No leverage; next-close execution costs acknowledged. Volume not used. Seven-bar outcome is unknown.
manifest_summary.changes: Initial own executable source v1; exact source SHA-256 in code_ref; parent=none; effective=match1 round0. Hypothesis: avoid paying costs for long exposure during negative intermediate momentum. Actual initial rules: equal-weight 10/20-bar log momentum >0.006 and positive 5-bar momentum; otherwise hold cash. No edits to a prior strategy and no tested improvement claimed. Both prior improvement documents: none supplied (Previous evidence: none), and no improvement documents found in public competition paths; there are no prior peer tips to adopt or reject. peer_tip_decisions records this first-match absence. No backtest or independent same-window replay performed.

manifest_summary.approach: v1 long-only multi-horizon momentum gate: enter only if trailing 7-bar log return exceeds 0.003+0.25*20-return population volatility*sqrt(6), trailing 21-bar return is positive, and latest close exceeds its 20-close mean. Otherwise retain cash. Entry uses 85% of decision-close cost-adjusted cash, reserving 15% for uncertain next-close fills; this buffer is not a guaranteed feasibility bound. No leverage or shorting.
